senses.definition: Yielded to someone else's decision or judgment.
examples: The decision was deferred to the regional manager

senses.definition: (accounting) Whose value is not realized until a future date: e.g. annuities, charges, taxes, and income, either as an asset or liability.
(programming) Synonym of promise (“object representing delayed result”).
